meta.assembly_note_before_pallet_fork: In order to test the freedom of gear train, before assembling the pallet fork turn the stem in the winding direction and check that the gear train at the end of its free motion forward turn slightly back before stopping definitively.

steps.note: MAKE SURE THERE IS NO FORCE ON THE MAIN SPRING !
